scope: Read-only comparison of already captured ordinary-recording traces; no replay or native build ran locally.
measured_findings: All ten lost frames retain selected and active logical note 52 with assigned_mask=1 and committed_mask=1 in both modes. Age, phase and evidence state agree.
OFF renders note 52 on lane 1 (mask 2); ON renders it on lane 0 (mask 1) in all ten lost frames.

At sample 945151, logical note 41 has assigned mask 2 ON versus 4 OFF. At 945215 ON emits note-52 off on lane 1 and on on lane 0. At 945279 note 41 moves back to lane 2; at 945343 note 52 returns to lane 1.
OFF emits no note-52 MIDI events during this first transfer. The regression is an actual output-lane transfer, not disappearance of the logical note or only a preview-score change.
supported_inference: The one-decision delay is consistent with changed note-41 occupancy affecting note-52 continuity state after lifecycle rendering, then changing the next desired output lane. Assignment receives the filtered ownership selection while continuity receives the original selection. This identifies a routing seam, not proof of which unrecorded mask changed.

source_pointers.role: Desired output mask can override singleton assignment using spectral and compatible continuity masks.
Continuity classification uses other active candidates assigned and MIDI masks.
Filtered selection enters joint string assignment.
Lifecycle renders desired lanes and emits MIDI transfers.
Continuity tracker updates after lifecycle using original selection.

not_measured: Candidate 52 spectral_lane_mask, continuity_lane_mask, continuity_cached_group_mask and desired output mask at the deciding stages.
Stable held-MIDI improvement or live-host readiness.
next: Capture only those routing fields around the first transfer in a default-off GitHub diagnostic. Require exact baseline replay identity. If identical masks produce differing desired lanes, this path is falsified. Any later runtime fix must gain whole-recording matches with zero per-label losses and no increase in wrong-note, wrong-string or extra gap outputs.
